text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I make my way to the exit after
watching a
race, I notice an Umamusume
holding her head in
despair.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah... Business has been so bad
lately. At this rate, the future of my
Golshi-brand yakisoba will
go up in
delicious smoke...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there! Gimme an idea on how
to pull my
business out of its
freewheeling nosedive!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If I make it any tastier than it already
is, it'll
jeopardize all the other yakisoba
joints in the
galaxy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mediocre quality brings more peace of
mind...
Which means!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The flavor is fine just as it is! Yeaaah,
buddy! I
have no idea why, but I'm
pumped!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess what's important is motivation.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! Of all the things you
could've suggested, akashiyaki?!
Everyone knows takoyaki
would've been
the better suggestion!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the galactic economy would go
haywire
if I sell anything other than
yakisoba!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
As a token of my gratitude, I'll tell ya
the most
important thing when it comes
to making
takoyaki.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You listening? It's all about rhythm.
Start
off nice
and gentle, then crank up the
speed at the end!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ya gotta feel the beat too, yo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Start off gentle then gradually speed
up... That
might actually be a good tip
when running on
certain tracks...
